apaCitation: Pergolizzi, J., Kraus, A., Magnusson, P., Breve, F., Mitchell, K., Raffa, R., LeQuang, J. A. K., & Varrassi, G. (2022). Treating apnea of prematurity. Cureus, 14(1), e21783. https://doi.org/10.7759/cureus.21783
bestFor: Supporting overview of apnea-of-prematurity physiology/natural history, caffeine and methylxanthine treatment context, uncertainty around treatment timing and duration, noninvasive respiratory support, lower-evidence interventions, and evidence gaps.
currencyNote: 2022 narrative review, not a guideline. The source itself describes areas of limited consensus and should be used as a treatment-landscape/evidence-summary source rather than a protocol.
authorityBoundary: Supplemental neonatal review only. Current neonatal guidance, prescribing information, physician orders, institutional protocols, device instructions, and facility policy govern treatment. Current AASM Scoring Manual Version 3 infant/pediatric respiratory rules govern PSG scoring when formal sleep-study scoring applies. Do not convert medication doses, respiratory-support settings, positioning discussion, or experimental interventions in this review into technologist instructions.
copyrightUse: Use bibliographic metadata, section labels, page locators, and original Sleep Pathways Guild study directions only. Do not reproduce protected review prose, tables, figures, or substantial passages.
